rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making an amount or quantity smaller.

example.english: The company needs to reduce the plastic used in packaging.
example.traditional: 公司要減少包裝用嘅膠。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jiu3 gaam2 siu2 baau1 zong1 jung6 ge3 gaau1

rows.note: Use this for lowering a level, intensity, risk, cost, or similar measurable property rather than simply reducing a quantity.

example.english: Closing the door when the air conditioner is on can reduce electricity consumption.
example.traditional: 開冷氣嗰陣閂門，可以減低耗電量。
example.jyutping: hoi1 laang5 hei3 go2 zan6 saan1 mun4 ho2 ji5 gaam2 dai1 hou3 din6 loeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically when reducing body weight or trying to lose weight.

example.english: I’m eating less rice and working hard to reduce my weight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 siu2 di1 faan6 nou5 lik6 gaam2 fei4

rows.note: Use this when someone is moved to a lower job position or rank.

example.english: The boss demoted him to reduce his rank because he was always late.
example.traditional: 老闆因為佢成日遲到，將佢降職。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 jan1 wai6 keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zoeng1 keoi5 gong3 zik1
